title: Down Dog Session Failure Rate
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=downdog:session
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(session_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by practice_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Down Dog session records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each practice type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize session_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per practice type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Down Dog session data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
